title: 20 Ways or 10 Teams? Combinations Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Five friends and a quiz team of two. With captain and vice captain badges there were 20 ways. With no badges, Meera and Sana is the same team as Sana and Meera. So is it still 20? When order does not matter, we count combinations. This animated lesson follows NCERT Chapter 6, Permutations and Combinations (Class 11).

You will watch the 5 x 5 grid from the last episode fold along its diagonal, each pair landing on its mirror twin, until 20 ordered pairs become 10 teams. Then we build nCr = nPr / r! and the factorial form n! / (r! (n-r)!), and watch the number of teams rise and fall as the team grows, which shows why nCr = nC(n-r). Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with 3 of 8 friends going on a trip, the exam trap of using nPr for a group, an original JEE Main pattern question on a team with at least two girls, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
